minor.issue: Spec row P says 1500kg → luton_van but engine returns 3_5t_truck. Root cause: luton_van capacity_kg=1200 in DEFAULT_PRICING_CONFIG, and _pick_transport_vehicle escalates to 3_5t_truck when weight > 1200. Either raise luton_van.capacity_kg to 1500 (matches real-world 3.5t chassis) OR update the R25 spec/vehicle tier table to reflect that 1500kg is genuinely a 3.5t truck job. Not a functional bug — the picker is deliberately conservative — but the spec/config are inconsistent. All other weight/volume tiers in section P/Q match the spec exactly (250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000 kg and 0.5, 5, 10, 17, 28 m³).

rca of the issue: 1500kg tier mismatch RCA: services/pricing._pick_transport_vehicle uses `if w > 1200 or v > 18: return '3_5t_truck'`. The threshold 1200 aligns with luton_van's own capacity_kg=1200 in DEFAULT_PRICING_CONFIG. The R25 spec asserts 1500kg should still be luton_van, but that would exceed the vehicle's declared payload capacity. Recommended mitigation: update luton_van.capacity_kg to 1500 (many real Luton bodies do haul 1400–1500kg) AND change the picker threshold to `w > 1500 or v > 18`. Alternatively accept the current, more conservative behaviour and update the spec document.
